summary: You pay for AI by the token and every model has a token limit, yet you write in words. You count tokens with tiktoken, see that punctuation, digits and other scripts cost differently, see the same Thai sentence cost 6 or 18 tokens on two tokenizers, and measure how much of a context window your knowledge base uses.
goal: Count the tokens of a document in code and say how much of a context window it uses.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then guess the hook
Step 1: install tiktoken, run show_tokens.py and match the six lines
Step 2: switch to cl100k_base, predict which counts change, then check
Step 3: trigger the special-token error, the unknown-encoding error and a None error, and read each
Step 4: count the tokens of the 20 documents and how much of an 8,000-token window they use
Play the Token Counter game to the end and see your score
